transcript: I will destroy six of your biggest fears in less than 60 seconds. Listen to me carefully, my friend. Number one, I am scared of what people think about me. Most people are too busy suffering inside their own mind to spend much time thinking about yours. Number two, I am scared of what people will say about me. People speak for a moment, then move on. But the life you never lived because of fear stays with you forever. Number three, I am scared of making the wrong decision. Sometimes the wrong path still teaches the right lesson, but standing still teaches nothing. Number four, I am scared of taking risks. A boat that never leaves the shore never discovers the ocean. Number five, I am scared of failing. The master has failed more times than the beginner has even tried. Failure is not the opposite of growth. It is part of it. Number six, I am scared I am not ready yet. No one feels fully ready before changing their life. Courage comes after the first step, not before it. Remember this, my friend, fear is only the mind imagining pain that has not happened yet. Save this video for the days your spirit feels heavy. And if you wish to learn more lessons about peace, discipline, and the mind, my e-book is waiting for you in the link on my profile.
